description.zh: 按照实际的生效带宽值进行过滤，只允许输入正整数，单位Mbps。
description.en: Filters the results by the actual bandwidth. Only positive integers are supported. Unit: Mbit/s.

description.zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100。默认值：20。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20.

description.zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。

- 如果**NextToken**为空表示没有下一次查询。
- 如果**NextToken**有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌。
description.en:
A pagination token. It is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

- If **NextToken** is empty, no more results are returned.

- If NextToken is not empty, the value of **NextToken** is used for the next query.
The ID of the QoS policy.

description.zh:
流量调度策略队列描述。

描述可以为空或长度为1～256个字符，不能以http://或https://开头。
description.en:
The description of the queue in the QoS policy.

The description can be empty or 1 to 256 characters in length. It cannot start with \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`.
The ID of the queue in the QoS policy.

description.zh:
流量调度策略队列名称。

名称可以为空或长度为1～128个字符，不能以http://或https://开头。
description.en:
The name of the queue in the QoS policy.

The name can be empty or 1 to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`.
The ID of the inter-region connection.
The ID of the transit router.

title.zh: 查询流量调度策略队列的信息

descriptions.zh:
调用接口时请确保**TransitRouterId**或**TrafficQosPolicyId**或**TrafficQosQueueId**参数至少输入一个。

调用接口时请确保输入的参数值无误。如果您输入的参数有误调用接口后仍然会返回**RequestId**，但不会显示流量调度策略的信息。
descriptions.en:
When you call this operation, you must specify at least one of the **TransitRouterId**, **TrafficQosPolicyId**, or **TrafficQosQueueId** parameters.

Ensure that you specify valid parameter values. If you specify an invalid parameter, the system returns a **RequestId** but does not return information about the QoS policy.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cbn list-cen-inter-region-traffic-qos-queues --transit-router-id tr-bp1rmwxnk221e3fas0000 --transit-router-attachment-id tr-attach-a6p8voaodog5c00000 --traffic-qos-policy-id qos-rnghap5gc8155x0000 --traffic-qos-queue-id qos-queue-siakjb2nn9gz5z0000 --traffic-qos-queue-name qosQueueName --traffic-qos-queue-description qosQueueDescription --max-results 20 --next-token 2ca1ed1573cb0000 --effective-bandwidth-filter Gte=50 Lte=20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cbn ListCenInterRegionTrafficQosQueues --region cn-hangzhou --TransitRouterAttachmentId 'tr-attach-a6p8voaodog5c00000' --TrafficQosQueueName qosQueueName --NextToken 2ca1ed1573cb0000 --TrafficQosQueueDescription qosQueueDescription --EffectiveBandwidthFilter.Lte 20 --MaxResults 20 --EffectiveBandwidthFilter.Gte 50 --TrafficQosPolicyId 'qos-rnghap5gc8155x0000' --TransitRouterId 'tr-bp1rmwxnk221e3fas0000' --TrafficQosQueueId 'qos-queue-siakjb2nn9gz5z0000' --method POST --force
